items.name: 1. Spec Compliance
items.note: SKILL.md Step 7 now has a PR-flow block (record, add, commit, push, chained with &&) and a separate on-main block that commits but never pushes; the tag-stays-on-release-commit note is added.

items.name: 2. Error Handling
items.note: Both blocks chain with && so a failing record_event stops before commit and push; git add covers the first-release untracked events file. Pinned by the failing-record_event test.

items.name: 3. Security Basics
items.note: No secrets or user input; the test runs extracted blocks only against a temp repo with a stub tool and an isolated GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL.

items.name: 4. Test Quality
items.note: Behavioural tests execute the real fenced blocks against a clone plus bare remote and assert git outcomes (touched files, pushed refs, unchanged HEAD on failure); the static order pins were adapted, not weakened.

items.name: 5. Performance Basics
items.note: Prose change plus a 2s test module.

items.name: 6. Naming & Structure
items.note: New test file test_skill_event_blocks_behaviour.py beside the existing static pin file; both well under 300 LOC; no baseline file touched.

items.name: 7. Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; the events file is only appended by the unchanged record_event tool.

items.name: 8. Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff: no findings; the bash-missing skip hard-fails under CI per the silent-skip rule.
